eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 零出口 · 可审计

headline.zh:
一条命令
在内网 GPU 盒上跑编码 Agent
headline.en:
Run a coding agent
on your in-network GPU box

sub.zh: 数据不出境的国企研发，第一次像用云端 runner 一样顺手——每一次外发请求都留痕可审。
sub.en: On-prem R&D that finally feels like a cloud runner — every outbound request is logged and audit-ready.

hero.command: airtap run "给 server.go 加 /health 接口"

title.zh: 一条命令，告别隧道拼装
title.en: One command, no more tunnel juggling

body.zh: 以前在内网 GPU 盒上跑 agent，要手动拼 SSH、tmux、端口转发。Airtap 一条命令就连上、跑起来、流回你的终端。
body.en: Running an agent on an in-network GPU box used to mean hand-wiring SSH, tmux, and port-forwarding. Airtap connects, runs, and streams back to your terminal in one command.

title.zh: 出口只放行白名单，其余一律拒绝

body.zh: 守护进程拦下每一次外发请求，只放行白名单里的目标，每一次放行与拒绝都写进审计日志。默认只允许调到本地模型端点。
body.en: The daemon intercepts every outbound request, allows only what's on the allowlist, and logs every allow and deny to an audit trail. By default only the on-box model endpoint is allowed.

title.zh: 跑在盒上的国产模型，数据不出境
title.en: Runs on on-box domestic models, data stays put

body.zh: Agent 调用的是盒上本地服务的国产模型，不经过任何云——这正是它能进信创/国企内网的原因。
body.en: The agent calls a domestic model served locally on the box — no cloud in the path. That's exactly why it can enter 信创 / state-owned-enterprise intranets.

title.zh: 私有化部署，而非托管 SaaS

body.zh: 结构上不提供托管 SaaS——数据不出境的合规要求决定了它只能私有化部署。个人评估免费，组织授权按需。
body.en: No hosted SaaS by design — the data-not-crossing-border requirement means it can only be self-hosted. Free for individual eval; org licensing on demand.

headline.zh: 在内网 GPU 盒上开始
headline.en: Start on your in-network GPU box

sub.zh: 一条命令上手，零云上出口。
